kinds.label: Phone
kinds.wasteLabel: WEEE — device with battery and data
dos: Erase your data or factory reset.
Remove the SIM and memory card.
Hand it in at a point that takes phones.
donts: Don’t throw it in the trash or household recycling.
Don’t take it apart if the battery is swollen.
kinds.storage: Cool and dry, away from sun and metal. Don’t leave it in a drawer for months.
kinds.transport: Switched off, in a bag or box, without crushing it.

kinds.label: Computer
dos: Wipe the disk or destroy the storage.
You can donate it if it turns on, or recycle it at a computing point.
donts: Don’t throw it in regular trash.
Don’t leave it on the street.
kinds.transport: In a sturdy box or bag; tie cables so they don’t tangle.

kinds.label: Laptop
kinds.wasteLabel: WEEE — laptop with battery and data
dos: Erase your data or factory reset.
If the battery is swollen, don’t use it and take it to a specialized point.
donts: Don’t throw it in the trash or household recycling.
Don’t force or crush the battery.
kinds.storage: Closed, cool and dry. Don’t store it with a swollen battery.
kinds.transport: Switched off, in its sleeve or a box, without crushing the base.

kinds.label: Tablet
kinds.wasteLabel: WEEE — tablet with battery and data
dos: Erase your data.
Remove the SIM if it has one.
Cover the screen if it’s broken.
donts: Don’t throw it in regular trash.
Don’t bend or crush it.
kinds.storage: Flat, dry and away from heat.
kinds.transport: Switched off, wrapped so the glass can’t cut.

kinds.label: Charger
dos: If it works, reuse or donate it.
If it’s damaged, recycle it as WEEE.
donts: Don’t throw it in the trash.
Don’t use it if it smells burnt or overheats.
kinds.storage: Dry, cables coiled without tight knots.
kinds.transport: In a bag; keep loose terminals away from keys.

kinds.label: Battery
dos: Take it to a point that takes batteries (Pilas con el Ambiente or another take-back).
Cover the terminals with tape if they are exposed.
donts: Don’t throw it in regular trash or household recycling.
Don’t puncture it, throw it in water, or put it in a fire.
kinds.storage: Short time, cool and dry, terminals covered, away from metal. Don’t leave it for months.
kinds.transport: In a rigid bag or box, terminals isolated, without crushing it.

kinds.label: Cell
dos: Hand it in at a take-back battery point.
Keep button cells out of children’s reach.
donts: Don’t throw it in regular trash or household recycling.
Don’t recharge it if it isn’t rechargeable, and don’t put it in a fire.
kinds.storage: Dry container, terminals not touching each other. Don’t leave them loose for months.
kinds.transport: In a bag or jar; don’t mix bare terminals with keys.

kinds.label: Headphones
dos: If they work, reuse or donate them.
If not, recycle them as WEEE (especially with a battery).
donts: Don’t throw them in the trash if they have a battery.
Don’t open them if they’re swollen.
kinds.storage: Dry, without crushing the charging case.
kinds.transport: In their case or a bag.

kinds.label: TV
dos: If it turns on, you can donate it.
Broken screen: wrap it and take it to a WEEE point.
donts: Don’t throw it in the trash or leave it on the sidewalk.
Don’t take it apart at home.
kinds.storage: Upright, dry, out of the way.
kinds.transport: Standing or as the maker says; ask for help with the weight. Cover the glass.

kinds.label: Printer
risks: Data in memory if it’s networked
dos: Remove cartridges and wipe memory if you can.
Donate it if it prints, or recycle it.
donts: Don’t throw it in the trash.
Don’t shake loose toner.
kinds.storage: Dry, with cartridges in or in a bag so they don’t dry or leak.

kinds.label: Cables
kinds.blurb: Cables, USB chargers, or extension cords.
dos: Reuse them if they aren’t frayed.
Recycle damaged ones as WEEE.
donts: Don’t burn them to extract copper.
Don’t leave frayed cables outdoors.
kinds.transport: In a bag; avoid knots with other metal.

kinds.label: Peripheral
kinds.blurb: Mouse, keyboard, webcam, or other accessory.
dos: If it works, donate or reuse it.
Remove loose cells and recycle them separately.
donts: Don’t throw it in the trash.
Don’t leave cells inside if it will sit for months.
kinds.storage: Dry; take cells out if you won’t use it.
kinds.transport: In a bag, terminals covered if cells are loose.

kinds.label: Small appliance
dos: If it works, reuse or donate it.
If not, recycle it as WEEE, not as trash.
donts: Don’t throw it in the trash if it has a motor, battery, or cable.
Don’t wash the inside if it plugs in.

kinds.label: I don’t know what it is
kinds.blurb: Pick the category by hand if the photo isn’t enough.
risks: It may have a battery or data
dos: Pick the category to see what to do.
donts: Don’t throw it in the trash if it might have a battery.
kinds.storage: Dry and apart until you know what it is.
kinds.transport: Don’t crush it; cover terminals if you see a loose battery.
